mood: A side street at the dome's foot, a white-gloved hand, and a third question asked in the dark.

hero.alt: On a smoky, ruined street a pink-haired girl and a black-haired girl in school uniform stand back to back, a fist up and a staff raised, two round drones beside them and clawed Enders closing in.

media.alt: Out of gray smoke a black-haired girl in school uniform reaches a white-gloved hand toward the viewer, her long hair streaming and a staff held low in her other hand.

inserts.caption: A hand held out through the smoke.
